conclusions: All 16 catalog controls have public native preview metrics and coupled/detached controller coverage across R297-R301.

Control-specific interactions remain partial: push/toggle/check/radio, scrollbars and arrows have direct interaction evidence; seven actionable controls still need directed interaction checks. Frame is structural and progress is passive, so their verification is visual/value based rather than clicking.
The public GTK2 normal-state arrow glyphs match all four retained SR10.4 cells at 1:1 in R297. Historical held comparison is complete only for the lower arrow; left/right/up remain unverified.
remaining: Exercise interactions for the seven actionable controls without specific controller-input evidence: combo, horizontal and vertical scales, list selection, entry typing, text editing and spin value changes.
Compare historical held states for left/right/up when the VM image is awake and pointer target is visible.
Complete visual review with the user; do not install partial GTK2 recipe into XChat.

technical_coverage_estimate.basis: Same estimate as R301: all 16 types are mounted in the public preview and now have coupled/detached controller coverage, but several lack control-specific interaction checks and three historical held states remain unverified. This is not visual fidelity.
